title: Post-Clearance Audit (PCA) Operational Framework
summary: The PCA framework evolved from ad-hoc directives to a centralized, manual-driven operational procedure. It mandates strict adherence to audit manuals, risk-based selection, and systematic reporting to the NBR.

evolution.procedure: Shifted from discretionary audit activities to a standardized, manual-governed process with mandatory reporting.

timeline.change: Formalization of PCA procedures via a mandatory manual and reporting requirements.

member_objects.clause_title: পোস্ট ক্লিয়ারেন্স অডিট কার্যক্রম পরিচালনার কার্যপদ্ধতি
member_objects.resolved_text: ২। এ আদেশ জারীর পর সকল প্রকার পোস্ট ক্লিয়ারেন্স অডিট কার্যক্রম পরিচালনার ক্ষেত্রে এই ম্যানুয়ালে বর্ণিত কার্যপদ্ধতি অনুসরণ করতে হবে এবং এই আদেশের মাধ্যমে ইতোপূর্বের এ সংক্রান্ত সকল আদেশ বাতিল করা হলো।

Post Clearance Audit: This standing order mandates the application of the specific operational procedures detailed in the manual for conducting all post clearance audit activities.
The current order rescinds and replaces all previous instructions and orders related to the conduct of post clearance audit activities.

member_objects.resolved_text: ৩। এখানে আরও উল্লেখ্য যে, ম্যানুয়ালে বর্ণিত কার্যপদ্ধতি অনুসরণের ক্ষেত্রে কোনো প্রকার শৈথিল্য যেন প্রদর্শন করা না হয় তা নিশ্চিতকল্পে সংশ্লিষ্ট কমিশনারগণ প্রয়োজনীয় পদক্ষেপ গ্রহণ করবেন। উপরন্তু, এ বিষয়ে জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ডের সংশ্লিষ্ট শাখায় মাসিক প্রতিবেদন দাখিল করবেন।

Commissioner of Customs: The Commissioner of Customs is instructed to ensure that there is no negligence in following the operational procedures outlined in the official manual.
They are responsible for taking necessary actions to enforce compliance with these established procedures.
National Board of Revenue: The Commissioner of Customs must submit a monthly report to the relevant branch of the National Board of Revenue regarding the enforcement of procedural compliance.
Customs Procedure: Operational procedures described in the manual must be strictly followed without any laxity or negligence.

member_objects.clause_title: ৬.২.১ সিস্টেম বেইজড অডিট কার্যক্রমের প্রাথমিক ধাপসমূহ

System Based Audit: This standing order outlines the operational procedures for conducting system-based audits of business entities. It involves a structured approach encompassing initial planning, preliminary data collection, and the development of final audit programs.

The process requires audit teams to identify high-risk areas, analyze business profiles, and collect comprehensive data from various government and financial departments to inform their audit strategy.
Business Identification Number: Audit teams must use the Business Identification Number or Tax Identification Number to access and collect transaction data for the entities under audit as specified in the relevant annexes.
Tax Identification Number: The Tax Identification Number is utilized by the audit team as a primary identifier to retrieve and process transaction records for the institution being audited.
Customs Ruling: As part of the preliminary data collection process, auditors must review previous customs rulings related to the importer, such as those concerning product classification or valuation, to assess their relevance to the current audit.

Customs Post Clearance Audit Manual 2023: This manual outlines the standard procedures for conducting audits after customs clearance has been granted.
Risk Analysis: Risk management techniques are to be utilized as the primary basis for selecting individuals or business entities for post-clearance audits.
Customs Audit Selection: Operational procedures are established to determine the strategic selection of subjects for customs audits based on risk-based criteria.
